headline: Nifty and Sensex look to extend gains after rallying 2% last week; focus shifts to key triggers.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) turned net buyers last week after pulling out Rs 34,843 crore in October.
Strong buying in market heavyweights like Reliance and IT sector stocks lifted benchmark indices.
Crude oil prices remaining above $116 per barrel continue to influence market sentiment.
Cigarette tax hikes are expected to weigh on ITC Q2 profits, dragging earnings expectations.
whatHappening: Nifty and Sensex surged up to 2% in the previous trading week.
Commercial LPG prices were hiked by ₹10 per cylinder, and ATF prices rose by ₹1.37 per litre.
Primary market cools with 13 listings lined up following recent IPO activity.
Nifty IT registered an 18% rally, showing strong sector performance.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rallied up to 2% over the last week, supported by IT sector gains and renewed FPI buying. Investors are monitoring upcoming earnings releases, crude oil prices, and primary market listings. The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 2 November.
